stage: E9-lite calibration (re-scoring only, no new generation)

confidence_signal.limitation: chain format never asks for confidence; 0/360 scanned chains contained any verbalized confidence, so verbalized-confidence ECE is not computable from existing generations
confidence_signal.action: add explicit confidence slot to eval protocol before next big run

answer: PARTIAL mitigation: ECE falls monotonically with process-verification density (0.573->0.527->0.493, 14% relative) but all arms remain severely overconfident. Mechanism is MORE HEDGING (frac_unanimous 0.775->0.659), NOT better discrimination (AUC flat at ~0.62).

accuracy_matched_check.note: restricted to the 3/3 bin where ECE reduces to |1-acc|
accuracy_matched_check.verdict: ordering survives at matched confidence, so the gain is not purely the accuracy gain

circularity_retracted.why_invalid: score_chain per_step includes step['system'] = whether emitted crystal system matches truth = the same quantity as final-answer correctness; bravais/point_group/space_group likewise answer-coupled

valid_answer_independent.predictor: geometry step only (scored vs CIF lattice relations, no reference to the crystal-system answer)
valid_answer_independent.reading: answer-independent verifiable step predicts final correctness at AUC ~0.81, vs the model's own self-consistency confidence at AUC ~0.62 -> the CIF-grounded checker is a usable E7 reranking signal carrying information the model's confidence does not; near-identical across arms => property of the CHECKER not of a training arm

limitation.consequence: full answer-independent decomposition (geometry+motif) needs FULL generations, not stored; re-scored faith 0.263 vs eval-time 0.288
limitation.action: store full generations or a per-step score vector in the next eval run
limitation.note: geometry survives in 90.7% of the stored 400-char snippets while system survives in only 36% (motif 0%), so re-scoring truncated text does not measure eval-time faithfulness

literature.DCPO_2603.09117: RLVR severely suffers from calibration degeneration, models become excessively over-confident in incorrect answers; reports gradient conflict between accuracy and calibration objectives
literature.semantic_reward_2605.15588: binary correctness reward is indifferent to confidence, no penalty for confident-but-wrong, structurally incentivizes overconfident guessing
literature.hidden_costs_2509.21882: headline RLVR gains conflate policy improvement with budget mismatch, attempt inflation/calibration drift, contamination; recommends budget-matched curves with calibration and abstention tracking

caveats.AUC_ARTIFACT_WARNING: DO NOT quote AUC = 0.997-0.999 or r = +0.88 as 'faithfulness predicts correctness'. Those values, obtained for ALL arms, ARE AN ARTIFACT and are RETRACTED. score_chain's per_step vector CONTAINS step['system'], which scores whether the emitted crystal system equals the truth — i.e. the same quantity as final-answer correctness; bravais/point_group/space_group are likewise deterministic functions of (or tightly coupled to) the answer. Full-chain faithfulness therefore embeds the label and correlating it with correctness is near-tautological.
caveats.valid_replacement: Only the answer-INDEPENDENT geometry step is a legitimate predictor: r ~ +0.52-0.55, AUC ~0.81 (see step_to_final_correlation.valid_answer_independent).
caveats.truncation_caveat: Re-scoring the stored 400-char snippets does NOT measure what it claims: geometry survives in 90.7% of snippets (it is the first emitted step) but system survives in only 36% and motif in 0% (always past char 400). Re-scored mean faithfulness 0.263 vs eval-time 0.288. A full answer-independent decomposition needs the FULL generations, which were not stored.
caveats.confidence_signal_coarse: Vote-share confidence has only 3 attainable levels and is a self-consistency proxy, not verbalized or logit-based confidence; conclusions are about that signal only.
caveats.small_bin: The 1/3 bin is tiny (14-15 per arm) — the reliability curve's left end is noisy; ECE is dominated by the well-populated 3/3 bin (415-488).
caveats.no_seed_sd: Per-arm n=630 pools 3 seeds x 210 structures; seeds are not independent replicates of the calibration statistic, so no seed-level SD is quoted.
caveats.calibration_auc_compressed: The calibration AUC (vote-share separating correct from incorrect) is computed with ties at 0.5; with only 3 confidence levels ties are frequent, compressing AUC toward 0.5 for ALL arms. The FLAT comparison across arms is the robust reading; the absolute value is protocol-limited.
